notes.title: Early Access V1.0.1 Changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, first patch of the game I did some small but important changes that I'm going to list below.

Changes:
- Re enabled options for other aspect ratios
- Made some small aspect ratio changes
Please note: The game is made for a 16:9 aspect ratio, UI may not properly change yet but should all be visible and scaling. But the UI is not perfect yet, this will be in another update
- Gave a new color to selected buttons in the menu's
- Made navigating trough the menu's with a controller or arrow keys function better
- Implemented Steam API for the steam overlay
- Implemented Steam API for steam achievements (while in the main menu achievements will sync so you don't have to regather them)
- If you have the movement buffered the player starts moving immediately if the level loads
- The pause menu is now interactable if you have the achievement overlay active
- Made the chef use rubber banding, so he is more present in the levels

I think those were all the changes, I might release a new update before the drop of a new world again but that fully depends on all the troubles and bugs I run into during testing and with the feedback I gather. 

Have a nice day, and until the next update.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
In the past few days you might have seen some updates to the game if you've had it installed.

Today I finally figured out how to create patch notes so I'm going to list some of the currently known bugs and fixes together with some content I added since first launch. 

Changes since first release:
- Changed the font
- Added subtitles to the intro cutscene
- Added small decorations to the background
- Added a NPC Character in level 6 to make the levels feel less static
- Added a warning before level 5
- Added Hitmarkers
- Added pause functionality to the intro cutscene
- Changed training mode to checkpoint mode
- Added secret levels
- All achievements (except for hidden ones) are now visible in the achievements window

Bug Fixes:
- Made some improvements on the collision issues
- Hopefully fixed the issue which causes you to not be able to finish the first level

If you still can't finish the first level after the latest update, please go back to the main menu and continue or start the game again. This is a guaranteed fix for the issue, I can't recreate this issue every time so it is really hard for me to fix. If you still encounter the bug please join the discord and submit a bug report, if there is already one for this problem please just post a message saying you also encountered this bug.

Thank you for taking the time to read the patch notes and until next time :)
